info.title: v2.global_product.get_global_item_list
info.description: Get global item id list. Only for China mainland sellers and Korean sellers.

get.description: Get global item id list. Only for China mainland sellers and Korean sellers.

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: The token for API access, using to identify your permission to the api. Valid for multiple use and expires in 4 hours.

parameters.name: merchant_id
parameters.description: Shopee’s unique identifier for a merchant. Required for all merchant level requests(CB CNSC user calling global product related APIs).

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Specifies the starting entry of data to return in the current call. Default is null. if data is more than one page, the offset can be some entry to start next call.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: The size of one page. Limit is [1,50].

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: Partner ID is assigned upon registration is successful. Required for all requests.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by partner_id, api path, timestamp, access_token, merchant_id and partner_key via HMAC-SHA256 hashing algorithm. More details: https://open.shopee.com/documents?module=87&type=2&id=58&version=2

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: This is to indicate the timestamp of the request. Required for all requests. Expires in 5 minutes.

parameters.name: update_time_from
parameters.description: The update_time_from and update_time_to fields specify a date range for retrieving orders (based on the item update time). The update_time_from field is the starting date range.

parameters.name: update_time_to
parameters.description: The update_time_from and update_time_to fields specify a date range for retrieving orders (based on the item update time). The update_time_to field is the ending date range

200.description: Response documented by Shopee Open Platform.

<?php

$curl = curl_init();

curl_setopt_array($curl, array(
  CURLOPT_URL => 'https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/global_product/get_global_item_list?access_token=access_token&merchant_id=merchant_id&offset=AAAAFA%3D%3D&page_size=10&partner_id=partner_id&sign=sign&timestamp=timestamp&update_time_from=1611311600&update_time_to=1611311631',
  CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
  CURLOPT_ENCODING => '',
  CURLOPT_MAXREDIRS => 10,
  CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 0,
  CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => true,
  CURLOPT_HTTP_VERSION => CURL_HTTP_VERSION_1_1,
  CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => 'GET',
  CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => array(
    'Content-Type: application/json'
  ),
));

$response = curl_exec($curl);

curl_close($curl);
echo $response;
